name: Gigi Quach
bio: As President, Gigi brings analytical precision, creative strategy and past leadership experience to building an inclusive, connected DBAS where members embrace every opportunity.

name: Norint Ek
bio: As Vice President, Norint focuses on strengthening the society’s brand and engagement through data-informed strategy, backed by a creative streak in videography.

name: Emily Robertson
bio: As Secretary, Emily pairs organisation and a keen eye for detail with a passion for fashion, aiming to show members that analytics can be creative too.

name: Divyanshi Shaw
bio: As Treasurer, Divyanshi brings sharp analytical thinking and attention to detail to building a vibrant, inclusive community where students network with purpose and gain real industry exposure.

name: Marcus Huynh
bio: As Director of Marketing, Marcus brings analytical thinking, creativity and communication to DBAS, aiming to make it a welcoming community where students can connect and grow.

name: Jonathan Tan
bio: As Director of Business Analytics, Jonathan, a Vice-Chancellor’s International Scholar, enjoys turning numbers into decisions and wants to connect members with industry.

name: Riya Gupta
bio: As Director of Events, Riya brings creativity and event management experience to organising engaging experiences that encourage students to step outside their comfort zones and build meaningful connections.

name: Van Nguyen
bio: As Director of AI, Van develops AI initiatives, improves digital workflows and creates hands-on learning opportunities that put new technology to practical use.
